class.name: Intro
class.brief_description: [color=red](Not user creatable)[/color] A system node that plays the intro sequence when the game starts.

method.name: ready
method.description: A virtual method that can be overridden in a derived class to implement [b]game-specific[/b] initialization logic.

method.name: is_intro_completed
method.description: Returns whether the intro has been completed. Returns true when all intro sequences have finished or the user has skipped the intro.

method.name: next
method.description: Advances to the next step of the intro sequence. Can only be called manually to proceed to the next intro step when [member enable_auto] is set to false.

members.member: The file path of the scene to transition to after the intro is complete. If not set, the current scene remains active after the intro completes.
The path to the JSON file where the intro sequence data is defined. This file must contain the image, text, and timing information for each intro step.
The background music to be played during the intro.

Sets whether the intro sequence advances automatically. When set to true, each intro step automatically proceeds after the specified duration. When set to false, the [method next] method must be called manually to advance to the next step.

signal.name: intro_completed
signal.description: Emitted when the intro sequence is complete. [param skipped] indicates whether the user skipped the intro.

signal.name: started_intro
signal.description: Emitted when each step of the intro sequence begins. [param index] is the index of the current intro step.
